newsitem.title: UK: Johnson Matthey shares up on analyst visit.
newsitem.headline: Johnson Matthey shares up on analyst visit.

text.p: Shares in Johnson Matthey Plc rose to a near five-month high on Thursday amid talk of positive feedback from an analysts' trip round some of its U.S. operations, dealers said.
The stock was up 31p at 573-1/2 by 0809 GMT in volume of over half a million shares, extending its sharp gains of earlier this month sparked by annual profits at the top end of analyst expectations.

Dealers said there was talk that the company, whose products include packaging materials used to make microprocessors, was benefitting from technology developments and growing demand in the U.S. chip industry.
No-one at Johnson Matthey was immediately available for comment on the visit.
